description:
Designed with the lowest possible step-thru height, the Simple Step-Thru bicycle makes riding easier and safer. Coupled with the low-step thru, the frame geometry also features a forward pedal design. The pedals are positioned approximately four inches forward from where they are located on a traditional bike frame. This gives you the ability to keep your seat low to the ground while pedaling and still get great leg extension.

Dismounting is a breeze, no more need to swing your leg over an unnecessarily high-top tube, virtually eliminating the risk of falling or tipping over. Added safety features don’t mean reduced performance. Now upgraded with a 750-watt motor, this bike provides more torque for climbing steeper hills and navigating more difficult off-road terrain. Whether you’re cruising the streets or heading off the pavement, this bike is ready.

New 3” wide all-terrain tires offer extra grip and cushioning for both pavement and hard-packed trails. These wider tires add to the bike’s overall stability and help absorb more of the bumps and shocks during your ride—so your body doesn’t have to. The addition of a front suspension fork further improves comfort and control by smoothing out uneven ground, giving you better handling wherever you ride.

The upgraded 14Ah battery gives you an extended range of up to 60 miles per charge, depending on usage. Whether you’re commuting, running errands, or heading out for a recreational ride, this added range lets you go further with confidence. The smooth and simple electric motor allows you to decide how much effort you want to put in. Use pedal assist to amplify your ride or switch to full electric when you need a break.

The ergonomic riding position reduces pressure on your wrists, shoulders, back, and knees. Riders from 5’ to 6’2” in height can comfortably ride this model, which also supports a maximum weight capacity of 350 lbs. With comfort, power, and safety combined, this is a bike made to fit your lifestyle.

Key Features:

Ultra-Low Step-Thru Frame – Easy on and off for all rider levels, enhancing safety and accessibility.

Forward Pedal Geometry – Keep your seat low while getting full leg extension.

750W Motor – Increased torque helps you climb steeper hills and take on rougher trails with ease.

14Ah Battery – Extended range up to 60 miles per charge for full-day adventures.

3” All-Terrain Tires – Stability and comfort on pavement or trail.

Front Suspension Fork – Absorbs bumps for a smoother, more comfortable ride.

Pedal Assist & Full Electric Modes – Choose your workout or let the motor do the work.

Top Speed of 20mph – With pedal assist or throttle.

Front and Rear Disc Brakes – Strong, responsive stopping power.
